episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Katsuki Yuuri is at a crossroads after suffering a miserable defeat at the Grand Prix Finals. Uncertain whether to retire or to continue, Yuuri holes up in his family home. However, a chance circumstance causes him to catch the eye of five-time world champion Victor Nikiforov...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Out of nowhere, five-time world champion Victor Nikiforov declares himself Yuuri's coach. When world junior champion Yuri Plisetsky follows Victor to Hasetsu so that he can bring Victor back to Russia, the chaos only deepens...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: The two Yuris are to face off in Hot Springs on Ice. where they will each debut a short program choreographed by Victor—one to Eros, and one to Agape. Victor claims he will do whatever the winner wants, but...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The two Yuris begin to choreograph their free skate programs at their respective rinks. In Japan, Yuuri feels hesitant to pursue what it means to be uniquely him, but he begins to untangle his past by talking to Victor.

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: It is time for Yuuri's first competition of the season, but Victor's the center of attention as his first competition as a coach. Already anxious, Yuri's nerves don't get a break when Minami Kenjirou, the skater who beat Yuri at last year's nationals, confronts him...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The Cup of China, a Grand Prix Series event, is here! Realizing that he is the man who took Victor from the world, Yuuri gets worked up before his performance. Victor is concerned to see Yuuri this way for the first time...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Having finished the short program in first place—a first-time feat—Yuuri falters under the massive pressure. Can his fragile heart withstand Victor's roughshod intervention?

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Yuuri is determined to show his love to all of Russia in the Rostelecom Cup, the final event of the Grand Prix Series. In contrast, Yurio feels bogged down by his ties to Moscow, and tries to shrug them off. Before them, however, rises JJ, a rising star from North America...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Katsuki Yuuri has already obtained "love." With Victor's fading warmth in his heart, Yuri goes out to the rink for his free skate that will determine whether he'll qualify for the Grand Prix Final. Yurio firms his own resolve after eating special pirozhki, the epitome of love in Moscow.

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Barcelona is where the fated final battle will take place. Sightseeing during their free time, Victor is oblivious to Yuuri's resolve. Then, a chance remark reveals a nightmarish event at the banquet last year for Yuuri...

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Now armed with the light of love on his finger along with Victor, Yuuri goes for the gold in the Grand Prix Final as the chosen six competitors clash in the short program.

episodes_data.title: Yuri!!! on Ice Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: "Let's end this." Yuri's words trigger a debate that results in Yuri appearing at the free skate event in his worst condition ever. Can Yuri succeed in skating a program with the highest technical difficulty at their last event together to show the world the love he shares with Victor? What will each conclude once the program is over and it is time to decide their paths after the Grand Prix Final?
